printf '192.0.2.10 ana.example   # stand-in for public DNS: ana.example is a documentation name\n' >> /etc/hosts

apt-get install -y -q pebble >/dev/null 2>&1 && mkdir -p /etc/pebble && cd /etc/pebble && openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -nodes -days 3650 -subj '/CN=Lab ACME listener CA' -keyout ca.key -out ca.pem 2>/dev/null && openssl req -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -nodes -subj '/CN=localhost' -keyout key.pem -out req.csr 2>/dev/null && printf 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1\n' > ext.cnf && openssl x509 -req -in req.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -days 3650 -extfile ext.cnf -out cert.pem 2>/dev/null && printf '{"pebble":{"listenAddress":"127.0.0.1:14000","managementListenAddress":"127.0.0.1:15000","certificate":"/etc/pebble/cert.pem","privateKey":"/etc/pebble/key.pem","httpPort":80,"tlsPort":443,"ocspResponderURL":"","externalAccountBindingRequired":false,"certificateValidityPeriod":7776000}}' > config.json && cp ca.pem /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/lab-acme-listener.crt && update-ca-certificates >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemd-run --unit=pebble --setenv=PEBBLE_VA_NOSLEEP=1 /usr/bin/pebble -config /etc/pebble/config.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && for i in $(seq 60); do curl -sf https://localhost:15000/roots/0 >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done && curl -sf https://localhost:15000/roots/0

setup: printf '192.0.2.10 ana.example   # stand-in for public DNS: ana.example is a documentation name\n' >> /etc/hosts
su - ana -c "ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C ana@laptop -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 && ssh-keyscan -q -t ed25519 192.0.2.10 > ~/.ssh/known_hosts" && cat ~ana/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

setup.run: install -d -m 700 -o ana -g ana ~ana/.ssh && install -m 600 -o ana -g ana /dev/stdin ~ana/.ssh/authorized_keys

session: openssl s_client -connect ana.example:443 -servername ana.example -showcerts </dev/null 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^ *[0-9] s:|^ *i:'
